maria: Heads-up — thinking about staged activation semantics for on-prem bundles. We need a clean contract for fallback if activation fails mid-apply. :thinking:
aj: agree. current plan uses atomic swap + activation marker, but on-airgap we only have limited windows.
sanjeev: can you sketch the failure modes? e.g., partial file apply, service restart fail, incompatible runtime.
maria: yep. failure modes: 1) incomplete payload (agent crashed while writing) 2) post-activate healthcheck fails 3) dependent component version mismatch
aj: proposal: two-phase activation: "staged" -> apply files + verify checksums -> set activation marker -> perform service start -> post-start healthcheck -> finalize. rollback if healthcheck fails.
jonathan: how do we handle DB migrations in that flow? can't leave app half-migrated.
maria: DB migrations run after activation marker but inside a guarded transaction with idempotent up/down. if migration fails, revert activation and run down path. downside: long downtime.
aj: alternative: shadow migration: run migration in parallel on standby node, then switch traffic. but on small onprem installs no standby.
sanjeev: also need signed image chain and per-step sig verification. manifest example:
```
manifest: v2
components:
  - name: api
    version: 3.4.1
    sig: sha256:abcd...
  - name: runtime
    version: 2.1.0
    sig: sha256:ef01...
activation_window: 30m
```
aj: activation_window important. agent should refuse activation after window and leave bundle staged.
infra-bot: deploy-check: activation_window expired for bundle 2026-03-15T12:05Z -> auto-revert scheduled.
maria: ops question: should agent try incremental retries or give up and surface to console? prefer incremental with exponential backoff up to activation_window.
jonathan: and UI needs clear status states: staged, activating, activated, failed, reverted.
sanjeev: agree. add a "recovery_hint" blob in manifest pointing to manual steps.
aj: for compatibility anchors: require runtime >= min_version declared in manifest; agent enforces before apply.
maria: ok action items: (1) draft two-phase activation spec (aj) (2) add manifest fields: activation_window, recovery_hint, min_runtime (sanjeev) (3) add console states (jonathan). I'll post RFC follow-up.
jonathan: :thumbsup:
aj: will prototype agent state machine this week.
sanjeev: I'll add signature chain verification tests.
maria: thanks all, closing thread unless objections.
